name: Amir Prestige
notes: From their own listing drones (44 Via Roma, Isle of Capri, amirprestige.com.au, 2026-11-09). Wide drone pin: the white 'ap.' monogram on the sky with no circle or badge, a small gap, then a thin white line down to the house, with no dot and no outline. Location pins: white BOLD UPPERCASE wide sans labels (their site font is Garet; Söhne Breit Kräftig stands in) to the right of the top of a thin white line, with no dot and no distance. The close top-down oblique has no pin and no outline: the neighbourhood goes black & white and the lot stays colour (ZED-style mono surround). The monogram was cut from their 512 px favicon (logos/amir-prestige-ap-white.png), so ask for vector brand files before print. Sizes were estimated from 1920 px web copies.
